scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=server/api --workspace=client --workspace=adminClient --workspace=landing 2>/dev/null || (cd server/api && npx eslint . && cd ../.. && cd client && npx eslint . && cd ../.. && cd adminClient && npx eslint . && cd ../.. && cd landing && npx eslint .)
scripts.lint:fix: cd server/api && npx eslint . --fix && cd ../.. && cd client && npx eslint . --fix && cd ../.. && cd adminClient && npx eslint . --fix && cd ../.. && cd landing && npx eslint . --fix
scripts.dev:old: concurrently -n api,client,admin -c green,blue,yellow "cd server && docker compose up -d && docker compose watch api" "npm start --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix adminClient"
